deviation: The draft has no express confidentiality obligation or fixed post-termination period. It only requires return or destruction of confidential information on request and relies on a survival list of clause numbers, which may or may not include the confidentiality clause. Arcadia's protection could therefore be unclear or lost, with no 3-year tail and no trade secret protection.
suggested_text: Each party shall keep the other party's Confidential Information confidential, use it only for the purposes of this Agreement, and continue to do so for 3 years after the Agreement ends. On termination or expiry, each party shall return or destroy the other's Confidential Information on request. This clause survives termination or expiry of this Agreement.
